mission: Build the multi-coach agreement measurement engine so it is ready to run the day real qualified-coach reviews exist: blind multi-coach assignment planning plus agreement statistics on stroke identity, primary fault, severity, technique rating, drill selection, and cannot-evaluate frequency.
method: Reused the existing CoachReview v2 schema and its validator; no new review format and no changes to the truth boundary.

Implemented packages/swing-lab/src/coachAgreement.ts: deterministic load-balanced assignment planner (>=2 independent coaches per item, blind protocol documented, infeasible with <2 active coaches — never invents coach identities), plus Cohen kappa, linear-weighted Cohen kappa, Fleiss kappa, ICC(2,1), Spearman rank correlation, exact agreement / mean absolute difference, per-coach calibration offsets, drill-selection Jaccard overlap, and per-coach cannot-evaluate rates.
Disagreement surfacing: every multi-review item emits per-dimension disagreement records with per-coach verdicts; disagreements are preserved, never averaged or auto-collapsed into a consensus label.

Strict provenance separation: loadProductionReviews reads only datasets/coach-review/reviews/ and rejects synthetic/example/fixture coach ids; loadExampleReviews requires an explicit NOT_GOLD_SYNTHETIC_EXAMPLE marker and always reports provenance EXAMPLE_NOT_GOLD with realReviewCount 0.

22 focused tests including hand-computed kappa/Fleiss/ICC/Spearman worked examples, assignment determinism/infeasibility, honest N=0 reporting, disagreement preservation, and synthetic containment on the production path.
deliverables: datasets/coach-review/examples/EXAMPLE-synthetic-reviews.NOT-GOLD.json (fabricated fixtures, clearly marked, excluded from production loading)
datasets/coach-review/agreement/agreement-report.json (honest production run: N=0 real reviews, all metrics null)
datasets/coach-review/agreement/assignment-plan.json (INFEASIBLE — coach registry has 0 active coaches; planner refuses to invent identities)
datasets/coach-review/agreement/EXAMPLE-agreement-report.NOT-GOLD.json (pipeline-execution proof only; banner states it is not evidence)

Real coach agreement statistics: no kappa/ICC value here is evidence about technique truth until N>0 real reviews exist.
